definitions.explanation: The person who is speaking, as contrasted with the listener. Can also describe someone skilled at talking or telling stories.

examples.japanese: {話|はな}し{手|て}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}き{手|て}→聞き手：19792_kikite⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話|はな}し{手|て}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: He is famous as a speaker.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{話|はな}し{手|て}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{聞|き}き{手|て}→聞き手：19792_kikite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: A good talker speaks while watching the listener's reactions closely.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to speak) + ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (the agent suffix, 'one who does'). It carries two senses: the speaker in a conversation, contrasted with ⟦{聞|き}き{手|て}→聞き手：19792_kikite⟧ (listener); and someone good at talking or storytelling.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {話|はな}し{手|て}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}き{手|て}→聞き手：19792_kikite⟧: speaker and listener
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{話|はな}し{手|て}: a good talker

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{語|かた}り{手|て}→語り手：14271_katarite⟧: narrator, storyteller — emphasizes telling a tale
- ⟦スピーカー→スピーカー：04420_supiikaa⟧: speaker — usually the audio device, or a presenter at an event
